SELECT h.id AS hotelId, h.seller_account AS sellerAccount, h.name AS hotelName, COALESCE(w.balance, 0) AS pendingBalance, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(s.amount) FROM settlement s WHERE s.seller_account = h.seller_account AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' ),0) AS totalSettlementAmount, ( SELECT MAX(s.settled_at) FROM settlement s WHERE s.seller_account = h.seller_account AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' ) AS lastSettledAt FROM hotel h LEFT JOIN wallet w ON w.seller_account = h.seller_account
AND h.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND h.seller_account ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND COALESCE(w.balance,0) > 0
AND COALESCE(w.balance,0) = 0
ORDER BY ( SELECT MAX(s.settled_at) FROM settlement s WHERE s.seller_account = h.seller_account AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' ) DESC NULLS LAST
ORDER BY ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) FROM settlement s WHERE s.seller_account = h.seller_account AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' ) DESC
ORDER BY COALESCE(w.balance, 0) DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hotel h LEFT JOIN wallet w ON w.seller_account = h.seller_account
AND h.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND h.seller_account ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND COALESCE(w.balance,0) > 0
AND COALESCE(w.balance,0) = 0
